<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1536262826894" id="thunderdome-statement-994320">
<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;"><b>NOTE </b><b><em data-td-fact-id="34616739" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">7</em></b><b>. STOCKHOLDERS&rsquo; EQUITY</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Common Stock</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">The Company issues shares of common stock to the non-management members of the Board of Directors under the Company&rsquo;s <em data-td-fact-id="34616740" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2007</em> Long Term Incentive Plan&nbsp;(<em data-td-fact-id="34616741" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">&quot;2007</em> LTIP&quot;) and <em data-td-fact-id="34616742" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> Equity Incentive Plan (<em data-td-fact-id="34616743" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">&ldquo;2017</em> EIP&rdquo;) in respect of quarterly compensation. The shares vest over a <em data-td-fact-id="34616744" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em>-year period and are issued quarterly. The Company also gives the non-management members of the Board of Directors the option to receive shares of common stock in lieu of cash compensation.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 1, 2015, </em>the Company approved the issuance of <em data-td-fact-id="34616745" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">47,663</em> shares of common stock to the non-management members of the Board of Directors under the Company&rsquo;s <em data-td-fact-id="34616746" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2007</em> LTIP in respect of quarterly compensation. The shares vest over a <em data-td-fact-id="34616747" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em>-year period and are issued quarterly. The shares were valued at approximately <em data-td-fact-id="34616748" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$255,000,</em> based on the closing market price of the Company&rsquo;s common stock on the date of the grant.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">On&nbsp;<em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January 6,&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="34616749" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> the Company approved the issuance of <em data-td-fact-id="34616750" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">37,795</em> shares of common stock to the non-management members of the Board of Directors under the Company&rsquo;s <em data-td-fact-id="34616751" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> EIP in respect of quarterly compensation. The shares vest over a <em data-td-fact-id="34616752" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em>-year period and are issued quarterly. The shares were valued at approximately <em data-td-fact-id="34616753" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$241,000,</em> based on the closing market price of the Company&rsquo;s common stock on the day of the grant.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">On&nbsp;<em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 3, 2017,&nbsp;</em>the Company approved the issuance of&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="34616754" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">34,592</em>&nbsp;shares of common stock to the non-management members of the Board of Directors under the Company&#39;s&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="34616755" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em>&nbsp;EIP in respect of quarterly compensation.&nbsp; The shares vest over a&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="34616756" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em>-year period and are issued quarterly.&nbsp; The shares were valued at approximately&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="34616757" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$220,000,</em>&nbsp;based on the closing market price of the Company&#39;s common stock on the day of the grant.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">During the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="34616758" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> the Company issued <em data-td-fact-id="34616759" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">30,571</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="34616760" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">55,010</em> shares of common stock, respectively,&nbsp;for the vesting of shares granted to the non-management members of the Board of Directors under the Company&rsquo;s <em data-td-fact-id="34616761" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2007</em> LTIP and <em data-td-fact-id="34616762" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> EIP and in lieu of cash compensation.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;"><b>&nbsp;</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Treasury Stock</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">During the year ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018, </em>the Company repurchased and retired&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="34616763" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">5,599</em> shares of common stock in treasury, at a cost of <em data-td-fact-id="34616764" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$47,000.</em>&nbsp; During the year ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2017, the Company retired&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="34616765" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">785,000</em> shares of common stock in treasury, with an original cost of <em data-td-fact-id="34616766" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2.4</em> million.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;<b>Stock-Based Compensation</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">Stock-based compensation expense for restricted stock and stock issuances of <em data-td-fact-id="34616767" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.6</em>&nbsp;million and <em data-td-fact-id="34616768" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.4</em> million&nbsp;was recorded in the&nbsp;years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="34616769" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> respectively, and was recorded primarily in general and administrative expenses in the statements of comprehensive income.&nbsp; As of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018, </em><em data-td-fact-id="34616770" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.3</em> million of total unrecognized stock-based compensation expense related to restricted stock is expected to be recognized over approximately <em data-td-fact-id="34616771" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">5.8</em> years.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">The aggregate intrinsic value represents the total pre-tax amount of proceeds, net of the exercise price, which would have been received by the option holders if all option holders had exercised and immediately sold all options with an exercise price lower than the market price of the Company&#39;s common stock on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018.</em></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:13.5pt;margin-right:15pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;During the&nbsp;year ended&nbsp;<em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018,&nbsp;</em>the Company granted&nbsp;a total of&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="34616772" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">240,000</em>&nbsp;restricted shares of common stock to employees under the&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="34616773" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em>&nbsp;EIP, valued at&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="34616774" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.5</em>&nbsp;million.&nbsp; The restricted stock vests when the Company&#39;s volume weighted average price (&quot;VWAP&quot;) per share is at or above certain levels.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 15pt; text-align: justify;">During the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="34616779" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> the Company withheld <em data-td-fact-id="34616780" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">4,531</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="34616781" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">26,535</em> shares of common stock at a cost of <em data-td-fact-id="34616782" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$33,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="34616783" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.2</em> million, respectively,&nbsp;for the payment of taxes on shares that vested during the year.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:left;"><b>Employee Stock Purchase Plan</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;"><b>&nbsp;</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">The Company has established Employee Stock Purchase Plans (&quot;ESPP Plans&quot;). Under the ESPP Plans, the Company will grant eligible employees the right to purchase common stock through payroll deductions.&nbsp;US employees purchase stock at a price equal to the lesser of <em data-td-fact-id="34616784" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">85</em> percent of the fair market value of a share of the Company&rsquo;s common stock on the Exercise Date (as defined under the ESPP Plans)&nbsp;of the current Offering Period (as defined under the ESPP Plans) or <em data-td-fact-id="34616785" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">85</em> percent of the fair market value of the Company&#39;s common stock on the Grant Date (as defined under the ESPP Plans) of the Offering Period.&nbsp; UK employees purchase at a price equal to the lesser of&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="34616786" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100</em> percent of the fair market value of a share of the Company&rsquo;s common stock on the Exercise Date of the current Offering Period or <em data-td-fact-id="34616787" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100</em> percent of the fair market value of the Company&#39;s common stock on the Grant Date of the Offering Period, but receive a <em data-td-fact-id="34616788" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">15</em> percent&nbsp;matching contribution from the Company.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">During the&nbsp;years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="34616789" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> the Company issued <em data-td-fact-id="34616790" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">14,712</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="34616791" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">13,835</em> shares of common stock, respectively, to employees, including executive officers, under the ESPP in lieu of compensation, which shares of common stock were valued at approximately <em data-td-fact-id="34616792" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.1</em> million based on the closing market price of the Company&rsquo;s common stock on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January 1, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 1, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="34616793" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.1</em> million based on the closing market price of the Company&rsquo;s common stock on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2016 </em>and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> July 1, 2016, </em>respectively.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1536262833040" id="thunderdome-statement-994324">
<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;"><b>NOTE </b><b><em data-td-fact-id="34616794" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">8</em></b><b>. EMPLOYEE BENEFIT PLANS</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">The Company has a retirement plan that complies with Section <em data-td-fact-id="34616795" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">401</em>(k) of the Internal Revenue Code. All&nbsp;US employees are eligible to participate in the plan. The Company&rsquo;s contribution to the <em data-td-fact-id="34616796" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">401</em>(k) Plan is at the discretion of the Board of Directors. The Company matches <em data-td-fact-id="34616797" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100%</em> of elective deferrals subject to a maximum of <em data-td-fact-id="34616798" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3%</em> of the participant&rsquo;s eligible earnings. The Company&rsquo;s matching contributions to the <em data-td-fact-id="34616799" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">401</em>(k) for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="34616800" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> were <em data-td-fact-id="34616801" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.1</em> million&nbsp;and <em data-td-fact-id="34616802" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.1</em> million,&nbsp;respectively.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;">The Company has a defined contribution retirement plan (&quot;UK Plan&quot;)&nbsp;that all UK employees are eligible to participate in. &nbsp;The Company&rsquo;s contribution&nbsp;to the UK&nbsp;Plan&nbsp;is at the discretion of the Board of Directors. The Company matches <em data-td-fact-id="34616803" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100%</em> of elective deferrals subject to a maximum of <em data-td-fact-id="34616804" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3%</em> of the participant&rsquo;s eligible earnings. The Company&rsquo;s matching contributions to the UK Plan&nbsp;for the years ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> June 30, 2018 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="34616805" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> were <em data-td-fact-id="34616806" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.2</em> million&nbsp;and <em data-td-fact-id="34616807" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.2</em> million,&nbsp;respectively.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 15pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>
